description: FY2024-25 pre-Budget rates for listed equity, effective from the start of the financial year until 22 July 2024. Superseded by 2024-07-23.json.
source: Income-tax Act provisions as they stood before Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024. NOT YET REVIEWED BY A QUALIFIED CA - see README.

shortTerm.description: STT-paid short-term capital gains on listed equity, held 12 months or less.

longTerm.description: Long-term capital gains on listed equity, held more than 12 months. Flat rate, no indexation. The exemption applies once per financial year across all LTCG put together - not once per trade.

section87ARebate.note: The Section 87A rebate does not apply to STCG under 111A or LTCG under 112A, even when total income is below the rebate threshold. This surprises most beginners - it is surfaced as a standing warning, not just a footnote.

grandfathering.description: For shares acquired on or before 31 Jan 2018: cost of acquisition = higher of (actual cost) and (lower of (fair market value on 31 Jan 2018, actual sale price)). The sale-price cap stops a stale, higher FMV from manufacturing a loss that isn't real when the price has fallen since Jan 2018.

intraday.description: Intraday equity is speculative business income, not a capital gain - taxed at your income slab rate, reported in Schedule BP, not Schedule CG.

fno.description: F&O is non-speculative business income, not a capital gain - taxed at your income slab rate, reported in Schedule BP, not Schedule CG.

lossSetOff.note: Unabsorbed capital losses carry forward for 8 assessment years, but only if the return is filed by the original due date. Missing the due date forfeits the carry-forward entirely - this is the single most expensive avoidable mistake in this area.

brokerage.description: Illustrative discount-broker figures - ₹20 or 0.03% of turnover per executed order, whichever is lower, for intraday/F&O; ₹0 for delivery. Not any specific broker's actual tariff.

transactionCharges.note: STT/exchange-charge/SEBI-fee/stamp-duty figures are best-effort as of this rate set's effective date and are subject to CA review before launch, per the README disclaimer. F&O STT here reflects the pre-1-Oct-2024 rates (lower than 2024-07-23.json's, which already includes the October revision - the STT step happened partway through the period this file otherwise covers; treat the F&O figures in this file as approximate for trades between 23 Jul and 30 Sep 2024).
